product_updates.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
product_updates.content: A top executive at the AI lab told the Wall Street Journal that the model in question had displayed a poor aptitude for following orders.

product_updates.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
product_updates.content: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.

product_updates.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
product_updates.content: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

product_updates.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
product_updates.content: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

product_updates.title: The AI boom took over Climate Week and not everyone is happy about it
product_updates.content: Just like the rest of the U.S., data centers and AI are dividing climate tech founders and investors.

product_updates.title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
product_updates.content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

product_updates.title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, which it calls a significantly cheaper, faster work partner
product_updates.content: Anthropic has released the newest version of its mid-range model, boasting faster response times and less token burn.

product_updates.title: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
product_updates.content: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature that built task-specific agents.

product_updates.title: OpenAI still doesn’t seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity
product_updates.content: On Friday, OpenAI published a new site devoted to “misalignment reports” and the breadth of the incidents is alarming.

product_updates.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
product_updates.content: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.
